Elena Rostova
Data Scientist
Boston, MA | elena.rostova@email.com | +1 555-014-9921 | linkedin.com/in/elena-rostova-ds | github.com/erostova

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data Scientist with 5 years of experience leveraging machine learning, statistical modeling, and deep learning algorithms to solve complex business challenges. Expertise in Python, SQL, NLP, predictive analytics, and A/B testing to drive revenue growth and operational efficiency.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Data Scientist | Analytics Corp | Boston, MA | 2022 - Present
- Built predictive customer churn models using Python, Scikit-learn, and XGBoost, increasing model accuracy by 14% and saving $1.2M in annual retention costs.
- Designed and analyzed A/B tests across 4M active platform users, improving user conversion rates by 12%.
- Developed NLP pipeline using PyTorch and Transformers to categorize user feedback sentiment, reducing manual processing time by 40 hours per week.
- Automated interactive executive reporting dashboards in Tableau and Power BI, enabling real-time data-driven decision-making.

Data Scientist | Quant Insights | Cambridge, MA | 2019 - 2022
- Processed and feature-engineered multi-terabyte datasets using SQL, Pandas, NumPy, and PySpark.
- Implemented deep learning neural networks in TensorFlow for anomaly detection, reducing prediction error by 28%.
- Formulated hypothesis tests and multivariate regression models to optimize marketing campaign spend.

EDUCATION
Master of Science in Data Science | Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) | 2017 - 2019
Bachelor of Science in Statistics | Boston University | 2013 - 2017

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Programming: Python, SQL, R, Bash
- ML & DL Frameworks: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, SciPy
- Data Visualization & Analytics: Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn, A/B Testing, Statistics
- Tools & Cloud: Git, Docker, AWS S3, Snowflake, Jupyter Notebooks
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Data Scientist with 4+ years of experience in Python, SQL, machine learning, and statistical analysis. Key requirements:
- Expertise in Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch for building predictive models.
- Strong background in A/B testing, statistical modeling, and NLP.
- Experience visualizing data in Tableau or Power BI and presenting insights to executive stakeholders.
